items.name: espresso-crema
items.text: espresso pulling from a bottomless portafilter, tiger-striped crema braiding as it lands in the cup

items.name: latte-art
items.text: a rosetta poured in silky latte microfoam, leaves feathering out symmetrically as the pitcher lifts

items.name: old-fashioned
items.text: an old fashioned over one crystal-clear king cube, orange oils misting from a flamed peel, amber gradient in cut glass

items.name: red-wine-pour
items.text: red wine arcing into a wide-bowled glass, the stream folding into a crimson crown where it lands, backlight cutting a garnet rim through the rising swirl

items.name: matcha-whisk
items.text: matcha mid-whisk, bamboo chasen blurring, jade foam tightening in a raku bowl

items.name: citrus-splash
items.text: a sparkling citrus drink at full splash crown, droplets strung razor-sharp around a tumbling lime wheel, bubble trails still climbing the glass beneath

items.name: beer-pint
items.text: a condensation-beaded pint with a two-finger head, bubble trains rising in straight columns through the gold

items.name: smoothie-swirl
items.text: a berry smoothie layered violet over mauve, chia seeds held in suspension, the marbled swirl frozen exactly where the spoon left it

items.name: pour-over
items.text: a gooseneck pour-over blooming fresh grounds in slow spirals, the bed doming, first amber drips threading into the carafe

items.name: champagne-tower
items.text: champagne cascading down a coupe tower in golden threads, bubbles bursting in every catch

items.name: nitro-cold-brew
items.text: nitro cold brew cascading in reverse, a storm of micro-bubbles settling upward into a dense cream cap

items.name: gin-and-tonic
items.text: a balloon-glass gin and tonic, juniper berries and a rosemary sprig among oversized clear cubes, bubbles beading on the botanicals

items.name: sake-overflow
items.text: chilled sake overflowing its glass into the cedar masu box below, the deliberate spill caught mid-brim

items.name: mulled-wine
items.text: steaming mulled wine, star anise and orange wheels afloat, spiced steam curling up into cold air

items.name: bubble-tea
items.text: a brown-sugar bubble tea, dark tapioca pearls climbing streaks of caramelized syrup up the glass, milk marbling down through the cold tea

items.name: espresso-martini
items.text: an espresso martini under a dense tan foam cap, three coffee beans centered, the chilled coupe fogged everywhere fingers have not touched

items.name: turkish-coffee
items.text: Turkish coffee rising in a long-handled copper cezve, fine foam doming at the exact second before overflow, steam threading off the surface, a lokum cube waiting on the tray
